dryad_response_boundary.archive_semantics: observed non-pelagic bird species rows only
dryad_response_boundary.reason: the Dryad archive alone cannot distinguish an unreported species from a checklist-level nondetection

official_ebird_sampling_event_resolution.required_product: eBird Sampling Event Data / checklist-level export covering the intended 2002-2019 analysis period
official_ebird_sampling_event_resolution.access: official eBird data download for a logged-in user; separate from the Dryad species archive
official_ebird_sampling_event_resolution.scientific_role: response-independent checklist completeness and effort only
official_ebird_sampling_event_resolution.complete_checklist_semantics: only checklists with ALL SPECIES REPORTED=1 may later contribute nondetection information

allowed_before_species_response_access: file names, byte sizes and hashes
response-independent mapping of checklist coordinates to frozen island geometry

next_metadata_audit.goal: establish whether enough complete and effort-described checklists exist to define an island-year surveyed surface before any species outcomes are opened
report_only: fraction of Dryad-era island-years that would have defensible checklist-level nondetection support
next_metadata_audit.reason: first inspect only the response-independent Sampling Event Data support surface

candidate_status.not_stop_reason: official eBird Sampling Event Data can provide checklist-level completeness and effort independently of species outcomes
candidate_status.not_qualified_reason: the required Sampling Event Data extract is not currently present in Structural
candidate_status.next_action: obtain the official Sampling Event Data extract, then run a schema/coverage-only audit before opening the Dryad species archive

anti_selection: do not treat the published richness survey-completeness metric as species-specific absence
do not infer absence from missing Dryad species rows
do not inspect species outcomes to choose effort thresholds
do not use the eBird public API recent/summary endpoints as a substitute for the historical Sampling Event Data surface
do not promote the candidate after the non-supportive BALA result unless the pre-BALA frozen intake gates are satisfied
